words.definition: Work given to students by a teacher.
words.example: I finished the assignment before midnight.
words.example_id: Saya menyelesaikan tugas sebelum tengah malam.

words.definition: A formal talk given to students.
words.example: The lecture starts at eight o'clock.

words.definition: One of the two main parts of a school year.
words.example: Next semester I will take statistics.
words.example_id: Semester depan saya akan mengambil statistika.

words.definition: Money given to a student to help pay for study.
words.example: She won a scholarship to study abroad.
words.example_id: Dia mendapat beasiswa untuk belajar di luar negeri.

words.definition: The subjects taught in a school or course.
words.example: The school updated its curriculum this year.
words.example_id: Sekolah itu memperbarui kurikulumnya tahun ini.

words.definition: To study again before an exam.
words.example: I need to revise for tomorrow's test.
words.example_id: Saya perlu mengulang pelajaran untuk ujian besok.

words.definition: Being present at a class or event.
words.example: Attendance is checked every morning.

words.definition: To finish a course of study successfully.
words.example: He will graduate next June.

words.definition: A book used for studying a subject.
words.example: Open your textbook to page ten.

words.definition: A person who teaches one student or a small group.
words.example: My tutor explains grammar clearly.
words.example_id: Pengajar privat saya menjelaskan tata bahasa dengan jelas.

words.definition: An official test of knowledge.
words.example: The final exam is next Monday.

words.definition: A qualification given after finishing university.
words.example: She has a degree in economics.
words.example_id: Dia punya gelar di bidang ekonomi.

words.definition: A department of a university.
words.example: He studies at the faculty of engineering.

words.definition: A place where books are kept for reading.
words.example: The library closes at eight.

words.definition: The main subject you study at university.
words.example: Her major is computer science.

words.definition: Written information you keep to study later.
words.example: I review my notes before class.

words.definition: The head of a school.
words.example: The principal gave a short speech.

words.definition: A senior teacher at a university.
words.example: The professor answered every question.

words.definition: A short test of knowledge.
words.example: We had a short quiz on verbs.
words.example_id: Kami ada kuis singkat tentang kata kerja.

words.definition: Careful study to discover new facts.
words.example: Her research focuses on literacy.

words.definition: Someone who studies at a school or university.
words.example: Every student received a new book.

words.definition: An area of knowledge studied at school.
words.example: Maths is my favourite subject.
words.example_id: Matematika adalah mata pelajaran favorit saya.

words.definition: A plan of topics to be studied in a course.
words.example: The syllabus lists all the weekly topics.

words.definition: Money paid for teaching, especially at university.
words.example: Tuition fees rose again this year.
words.example_id: Biaya kuliah naik lagi tahun ini.

words.definition: A practical class where people learn by doing.
words.example: I joined a writing workshop last week.
words.example_id: Saya ikut pelatihan menulis pekan lalu.

words.definition: A long piece of writing based on research.
words.example: He is writing his thesis this semester.
words.example_id: Dia sedang menulis skripsi semester ini.

words.definition: A room used for scientific work.
words.example: The laboratory is on the third floor.

words.definition: A talk given to explain something to a group.
words.example: My presentation lasted ten minutes.

words.definition: Study done to prepare for an exam.
words.example: I planned two weeks of revision.
words.example_id: Saya merencanakan dua minggu untuk mengulang pelajaran.

words.definition: To officially join a course or school.
words.example: You must enrol before the end of August.
words.example_id: Kamu harus mendaftar sebelum akhir Agustus.

words.definition: Related to study, schools, or universities.
words.example: She writes in an academic style.

words.definition: An official document proving a qualification.
words.example: You get a certificate after the course.

words.definition: A room where lessons are taught.
words.example: The classroom has twenty desks.
words.example_id: Ruang kelasnya punya dua puluh meja.

words.definition: A series of lessons on one subject.
words.example: I signed up for an English course.

words.definition: A qualification from a college or university.
words.example: He earned a diploma in design.

words.definition: A long piece of academic writing for a degree.
words.example: He defended his dissertation last month.

words.definition: A short piece of writing about a subject.
words.example: Write a 500-word essay.

words.definition: A mark showing how good your work is.
words.example: She got a high grade in maths.
words.example_id: Dia mendapat nilai tinggi di matematika.

words.definition: Work a teacher gives you to do at home.
words.example: I finished my homework before dinner.
words.example_id: Saya menyelesaikan PR sebelum makan malam.
